"Seven nights above the water. The reef moves beneath your feet before you've made your first coffee."
✦ Must Stay · Sway Away Selection
Patina Maldives
Fari Islands · North Malé Atoll · World's 50 Best Hotels
Eight villa categories, all overwater or beach-facing. The overwater studio sits above a shallow lagoon reef — warm, clear, and completely private. The glass floor panel in the living room shows the reef below at all times. The private deck has a daybed, a dining table, and steps directly into the water. There is no check-in desk. You are met at the jetty by your host, handed a cold towel and a welcome drink, and taken directly to your villa.

Day 01
Arrival. Touch down, slow down.
Malé → Fari Islands
▾
PM
Seaplane Transfer
Land at Velana International Airport in Malé. Your Sway Away transfer host meets you airside. Private lounge access while the seaplane is prepared. The 25-minute flight over the atolls is the beginning of the trip — not a formality.
Insider: Book the left window seat on the seaplane. The Fari Islands approach from that side is extraordinary.
EVE
Villa arrival · First sunset
Your host takes you directly to the villa by boat. Champagne is waiting on the deck. No unpacking required tonight. Watch the first sunset from your overwater deck. The Indian Ocean at dusk is overwhelming — let it be.
LATE
Dinner at Roots
Patina's garden-to-table restaurant. The menu changes daily based on what arrived that morning. Order the fresh tuna and the coconut dessert. Book before you arrive — it fills every night.
Day 02
The reef is at your feet.
Fari Islands · House reef · Lagoon
▾
5 AM
Dawn snorkel from your villa
The house reef starts directly below your deck ladder. At dawn the water is still, warm, and completely private. Sea turtles feed on the reef at this hour. No equipment needed beyond what Patina provides in your villa.
Insider: Before any other guests are awake. This is the hour the Maldives belongs only to you.
NOON
Lunch at the overwater bar
Fresh tuna tataki, coconut rice, cold Champagne. The bar hangs over the lagoon — the water below is 3 metres of perfect clarity. Order the grilled lobster if it is on the board.
PM
Sunset dolphin cruise
The resort's private dhoni takes you out at golden hour. Spinner dolphins are resident in the atoll — they escort the boat most evenings. The Indian Ocean at sunset from open water is a different thing entirely to watching it from the deck.
Day 03
The private dinner.
Beach · Chef's table · Golden hour
▾
AM
Sunrise yoga on the deck
The resort's yoga instructor comes to your villa at 6:30. The session takes place on your overwater deck with the lagoon on three sides. One hour. Completely private. The best yoga you will ever do.
PM
Spa at Patina
The couples' treatment suite is built overwater. The 90-minute Maldivian ritual uses locally-sourced coconut oil and volcanic ash scrub. Book the sunset time slot — the light through the treatment room windows is worth the wait.
EVE
Private beach dinner · Arranged by Sway Away
A table for two in the sand. No other guests within sight. The executive chef personally designs the menu — it arrives as six courses, each one explained. The sommelier pairs each course with a different wine. The timing is set for golden hour so the sky changes colour while you eat. This is what Sway Away arranges while you pack.
This experience is pre-arranged by Sway Away. Your preferences are communicated to the kitchen before arrival.
Days 4 – 7 · More adventures await
Snorkelling with manta rays · Full-day sandbank picnic · Deep sea fishing · Island hopping by dhoni · Final sunset dinner at the rooftop bar

✦ Transfer · Arrival
Private Seaplane Transfer
Via: Trans Maldivian Airways · Private Charter
The 25-minute seaplane flight from Malé to Fari Islands is the beginning of the trip — not a formality. The Maldivian atoll from above is unlike anything else on earth. Turquoise lagoons, white sand strips, coral reef patterns visible from 1,000 feet. Private charter means no shared transfer schedule. You depart when you are ready.

✦ Experience · Evening
Sunset Dolphin Cruise
Via: Patina Maldives · Private Dhoni
Spinner dolphins are resident in the Fari Atoll year-round. They come closest to the surface at dusk, when they feed before nightfall. The resort's private dhoni takes you out at golden hour — just the two of you, your captain, and open water. The dolphins find you. They always do.
